workspace.settings.aboutBody: A workspace is a group of Bots on one shared computer. While {name} is selected in the sidebar, Chats and Bots show only its chats and Bots, and every Bot in it can see what every other Bot sees: the same logins, cookies and files. Put work that must not share a login or files in separate workspaces.
